## Fix these first

### 1. Tell people to search "Harbor invoice app", not "Harbor"
- Fix: say_the_query
- Repairs: Harbor, harbour, harber
- Evidence: "Harbor invoice app" puts https://harbor.so/ first; "Harbor", "harbour" and "harber" show no Harbor page in ten results.
- Hand-off: founder action. Put "Harbor invoice app" in the email signature, the talk and podcast intro line, and each profile bio.

### 2. Complete the LinkedIn and Product Hunt pages for Harbor
- Fix: claim_profiles
- Repairs: Harbor, Harbor app, Harbor review
- Evidence: https://www.linkedin.com/company/harbor-labs and https://www.producthunt.com/products/harbor-7 are other companies; no result in any search is a Harbor profile.
- Hand-off: founder action. Each profile names "Harbor invoice app" and links to https://harbor.so/.

### 3. Change the homepage title to "Harbor — Invoice app for freelancers"
- Fix: title_names_category
- Repairs: Harbor, Harbor app
- Evidence: the homepage title is "Harbor — Get paid faster", which never says invoice.
- Hand-off: site.health_improve with focus "homepage title".
